messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast Lockroom: final hygiene & commit stamps for board pack

Team — we have the board pack deadline next Wednesday. I need a quick, surgical cleanup of the forecast and the ARR numbers that will surface in the investor materials. Key asks (short):

- Sales: mark every commit deal as either "Commit" or move back to "Best Case" with a one-line reason. No ambiguous "On path" states.
- Finance: reconcile ARR math for renewals and add-ons (we found a duplication last quarter). Use the attached export as source-of-truth.
- Leadership: any pricing/credit exceptions must be routed through Vivek and show an approval note.

Attached: Q2_board_pipeline_export.csv (raw export).

Timelines: please complete updates by EOD Monday PDT so we can freeze the pack Tuesday morning. If anyone anticipates not making that window, flag now.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: Q2_board_pipeline_export.csv (CSV, 1.1MB)]

On Thu, Jul 2, 2026 at 9:12 AM Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — we have the board pack deadline next Wednesday...

Thanks Dev — pulling this thread together. I ran an initial pass against Salesforce and pushed a sanitized CSV here (attached) showing current stage + suggested commit status. High-level notes:

- ~120 opportunities in the Q3 book; 18 currently flagged as "Commit" by reps. I found 3 deals flagged as Commit with unsigned SOWs listed as closed-won — I've annotated them as "Commit (pending legal sign)".
- Two big add-on renewals (AtlasCloud and NimbusHealth) have billing cadence differences that affect ARR by ~$95k annualized if we treat them as pro-rated.
- Pipeline hygiene hotspots: EMEA deals with stale contact data and three opportunities >120 days since last activity.

Action items I will take by Monday EOD (per Dev):
- Drop bad duplicates and reconcile MRR->ARR mapping.
- Fill the commit_log_template.xlsx for all Commit deals with rep name, stamp date, and approver field.

Attached: Q2_board_pipeline_export.cleaned.csv, commit_log_template.xlsx

-Rishi
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast Lockroom: final hygiene & commit stamps for board pack

Thanks Rishi — good work. A few finance constraints and clarifications to ensure the pack doesn't require late edits: 

1) ARR calculation rule: use the standard rolling 12-month recognized revenue equivalent. For contracts with variable billing cadence, convert to an annualized committed amount (do not gross-up one-time professional services).
2) Renewals that include promotional credits should have gross ARR and net ARR lines; the board wants both visible.
3) Credit/discount exceptions: include the approver name, date, and link to the signed pricing exception (or mark as pending). If no approver, the item is treated as conditional and moved out of base ARR.

Specific items I flagged in the cleaned CSV:
- AtlasCloud: renewal shows $420k ARR but $30k is a one-time migration credit — net ARR should be $390k. Please split lines.
- Deal RDW-2026-ATL-43: currently Commit but procurement has not returned final PO. Move to "Commit (PO pending)" and add estimated close week + rep confirmation.

I'll be available for 30 minutes at 10:30am PT today if anyone wants a quick sync.

Thanks —
Maya Srinivasan
Head of FP&A
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast Lockroom: final hygiene & commit stamps for board pack

Folks — brief and explicit: the board pack will surface ARR, bookings, and top-3 risk items by account. I need the following before Tuesday 09:00am PT: 

- A single, validated CSV with final stage (Commit/Best Case/Out) and a one-line rationale column for anything not Commit.
- Commit log filled for every Commit deal with rep stamp + manager approval. Use the attached template.
- Any pricing/credit exceptions routed to me with the pricing_override_request.pdf filled and a short note (who approved).

If an account will materially change the ARR line (>= $50k), notify me and Dev immediately — we'll decide if the board packet needs an insert. For AtlasCloud (RDW-2026-ATL-43): I don't want it labeled Commit in the deck until PO is in hand. Rishi, please coordinate with Sara and procurement to confirm.

I'll review final packet Tuesday morning and will escalate any late exceptions to the executive snapshot.

-Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

[attachment: pricing_override_request.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

- Maya: finance validated ARR math and split AtlasCloud credit. Net ARR updated to $390k.
- Vivek: pricing exceptions submitted (2) — both routed; I added approver notes for one.

Outstanding: Rishi to chase Sara at AtlasCloud for PO (plan: follow up Tue morning). If PO is not in by Tuesday 09:00am PT we'll leave the line as "Commit (PO pending)" and include a 1-line risk note in the board pack.

Next steps: freeze by Tue 09:00am PT. I will assemble the board pack sections and drop the frozen CSV + commit log into the Drive link below.
